# Meteroid API

Every operation of the API, as a method of a `Meteroid` client (`client` below), by
resource. Each method also takes a last `requestOptions?: RequestOptions` argument: `headers`,
`query`, `timeout`, `maxRetries`, `idempotencyKey` and `signal` for that call. Methods return an
`APIPromise`, awaited for the body or asked for the response with `.withResponse()`. Models are
in [`src/models`](src/models).
